title: Dover Stone Church
content: Dover Stone Church, watercolorDover Stone Church in Dutchess County, New York is a dramatic split in a cliff face of metamorphic rock.If you step on the rocks in the stream that flows across the floor, you can enter the space inside, which leads back to a 30-foot waterfall.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)Now, Dover Stone Church is part of a 174-acrepublic preserve. It's a short hike to the site, and a great place to spend a summer afternoon.
